target.description: Migrate the bounded Visualforce account/contact explorer (LegacyAccountContactExplorer.page and LegacyAccountContactExplorerController.cls) to an additive Lightning Web Component and Apex implementation. Preserve account selection, an explicit contact-loading action, visible loading, empty, and safe-error states, stale-response protection, sharing and field-security controls, and include Apex and LWC Jest tests.
